title: bad smokes
description: this mod adds a cigarette, cigar, lit cigarette, lit cigar and lighter items
body: # Bad Smokes A simple smoking mod for Minecraft Forge 1.16.5, originally created for a bank heist video. ## Features 🚬 * Smoke cigarettes and cigars in-game * Custom smoking mechanics using lighter + item interaction * Visible smoke particles emitted from the player’s mouth * First-person smoking animation * Third-person smoking animation **(work in progress)** * Different behavior for cigars vs cigarettes **(work in progress)** ## How to Use ❓ 1. Hold a **cigarette or cigar in your offhand** 2. Hold a **lighter in your main hand** 3. Right-click to light it 4. Your character will begin smoking and emit smoke particles ## Notes 📝 * This mod is currently **work in progress (WIP)** * No crafting recipes are implemented yet * Features and animations will be improved over time ## This mod is perfect for: - Roleplay servers - Cinematics and machinima - Realistic or themed gameplay (heist, city, etc.) ## Credits & Usage 📜 > If you use, modify, or include this mod in any project, please **credit me as the original creator**. ## Donation ☕
